mechanism: Both modafinil and berberine are substrates and inhibitors of CYP3A4, potentially increasing modafinil levels and effects; berberine may also inhibit CYP2C19 which metabolizes modafinil.
action: Monitor for modafinil toxicity signs (headache, insomnia, tachycardia, hypertension); consider dose adjustment or therapeutic drug monitoring if combined use is necessary.
